headline: Chinese carmaker XPENG says it is aiming to start rolling out its IRON humanoid robot in Europe in the second half of 2027.
score_reason: Pool 6 kept: the timetable was announced on 11 Oct 2026, inside the window, and the headline matches the article; it is a company target with few details.
importance_line: A large carmaker is putting dates on bringing a humanoid robot to Europe, with commercial uses such as showroom tours first, but these are company targets with no named countries, price or sales model and no dates for home or factory use.
summary: Humanoids Daily reports that XPENG founder and chief executive He Xiaopeng set out a timetable for the company's IRON humanoid robot at its Paris Night event on 11 Oct 2026: mass production in late 2026, deliveries from the first half of 2027 and a European rollout in the second half. XPENG did not say which European countries come first, what IRON will cost or how it will be sold, and its first commercial uses are planned for its own sales centers and premises, such as tours, shopping assistance and patrols.
notes: Read in full via Humanoids Daily (fulltext). The sales-center uses come from XPENG's September statement as the article recounts it.
